thread:
maria: Quick summary from the 48h shadow run for v3.2q on a 20% crosscut slice — want a sanity check before we consider stepped promotion.

raj: TL;DR: p95 latency +3ms, token cost -22%, overall accuracy (NLU F1) -0.8pp, but baseline noise ~0.2pp.

tim: Can you break that accuracy drop by cohort? longform vs short Q/A?

maria: Yes — initial split: short (<128 tokens) delta -0.2pp, mid (128-512) -0.6pp, long (>512) -1.6pp. Also saw hallucination rate tick up on >512.

maria: query I used for slices:
```sql
SELECT cohort, COUNT(*) as n, AVG(latency_p95) as p95, AVG(cost_per_1k_tokens) as cost, AVG(f1) as f1
FROM eval_runs
WHERE model='v3.2q' AND run_tag='shadow-2025-11'
GROUP BY cohort;
```

eval-bot: Auto-summary — sample size 78k requests, p-value(f1_delta) = 0.006 for long cohort, effect size = -1.6pp, CI [-2.3, -0.9].

sara: Noted: hallucination classifier flagged 3.1% -> 4.8% on long answers. Spot checks show missing context tokens (KV warmup) in cold sessions.

ops-bot: infra note — observed CPU stalls on shard-7 during int4 decode bursts (logs below):
```
[2025-11-08T03:21:14Z] shard-7 decode loop blocked 120ms
[2025-11-08T03:21:15Z] evicting KV cache segment 0x7f
```

raj: That matches anecdata — long-context cost savings good but warm KV behavior seems degraded, causing more truncation/halluc.

raj: Proposal for auto-fallback rules:
- immediate rollback if any critical cohort shows absolute F1 drop >1.5pp AND p-value < 0.01
- OR if hallucination rate increase >1.0pp absolute on safety slices
- OR sustained latency p95 increase >10ms for two consecutive 15m windows
(These thresholds trigger a guarded promote->fallback action with 100% shift back to prior model)

maria: I like conservative thresholds. Also suggest a quieter alarm path: if mid-cohort drop between 0.5-1.5pp with p<0.05, throttle traffic to 5% and run a focused re-eval (top 500 fails).

tim: I'll run clustering on the 500 fails to surface common templates (KV misses, prompt truncation, tokenization edgecases). Will post results by EOD.

maria: Action items: (1) implement raj's rollback rule in promote job, (2) tim runs clustering, (3) ops to investigate shard-7 KV eviction pattern, (4) run focused rerun on the 500 failures and attach examples.

maria: tagging @sara to draft a short customer-facing note if we trigger fallback. :white_check_mark:
